extras: Works offline, no telemetry, requires Node.js 22.18+ and Python 3.10+ for development.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of keeping complex engineering components, schematics, and 3D models organized and viewable within a standard note-taking environment.

relations.evidence: editable .excalidraw.md drawings use the separate Excalidraw community plugin.

summary: Engiware imports packaged engineering components and allows lightweight images to expand into optional, on-demand 3D views.
